 Eight die of dengue, 1,595 get hospitalised
 Published : 11 November 2026
 • 
 Updated : 10 November 2026, 23:15
 • 
 CHATTOGRAM
 SHARE 
 Staff Correspondent 
 At least eight dengue patients died, and 1,595 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours till 8:00am yesterday, according to the Directorate General of Health Services. 
 Of the deaths, seven were reported in Dhaka division and one in Khulna division. 
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest fatalities, the country’s dengue death toll this year has risen to 474, while the cumulative number of cases has reached 1,53,768.
 Currently, 6,136 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals across the country.
 Experts said dengue cases might decline slightly this month, but a significant reduction was more likely in December.
 They said nearly 27 years of unsuccessful efforts to control dengue in Bangladesh showed the need for targeted, evidence-based mosquito control, particularly in residential areas.
